monetary-policy.summary: Markaziy banklar foiz stavkalarini qanday belgilaydi, bu stavkalar real iqtisodiyotga qanday yetib boradi va inqiroz paytida qanday vositalardan foydalaniladi.

gdp.title: Yalpi ichki mahsulot
gdp.summary: YaIM mamlakatda ma’lum davrda ishlab chiqarilgan barcha yakuniy tovar va xizmatlarning bozor qiymatini o‘lchaydi.
gdp.body:
Yalpi ichki mahsulot (YaIM) — ma’lum davrda mamlakat hududida ishlab chiqarilgan barcha yakuniy tovar va xizmatlarning bozor qiymati. "Yakuniy" degani ikki marta hisoblashning oldini olish uchun oraliq tovarlar chiqarib tashlanadi: novvoyxona sotib olgan un alohida emas, non narxi ichida hisobga olinadi.

Xarajatlar usuli mahsulotni kim sotib olishini qo‘shib chiqadi: YaIM = C + I + G + NX, bu yerda C — uy xo‘jaliklari iste’moli, I — biznes investitsiyalari (yangi uy-joy va zaxiralar bilan birga), G — davlat xaridlari, NX — eksport minus import. Pensiya kabi transfertlar G ga kirmaydi, chunki ular yangi mahsulot sotib olmaydi. Xuddi shu yig‘indiga daromadlarni (ish haqi, foyda, renta) yoki har bir ishlab chiqarish bosqichidagi qo‘shilgan qiymatni qo‘shish orqali ham erishish mumkin.

Nominal YaIM joriy narxlardan, real YaIM esa o‘zgarmas bazaviy yil narxlaridan foydalanadi, shuning uchun u faqat miqdorlar o‘zgarganda o‘zgaradi. YaIM deflyatori = (nominal ÷ real) × 100. Misol: nominal YaIM 14% ga, deflyator 9% ga oshsa, real o‘sish taxminan 14% − 9% = 5% ni tashkil etadi. Aholi jon boshiga YaIM aholi soniga bo‘lish orqali topiladi va turmush darajasining taxminiy ko‘rsatkichi hisoblanadi, ammo u bo‘sh vaqt, tengsizlik, norasmiy mehnat va atrof-muhitga zararni hisobga olmaydi.

Asosiy xulosa: YaIM = C + I + G + NX. Ishlab chiqarishni vaqt bo‘yicha solishtirish uchun real YaIMdan foydalaning va YaIM nimalarni hisobga olmasligini yodda tuting.

inflation-cpi.title: Inflyatsiya va narx indekslari
inflation-cpi.summary: Iste’mol narxlari indeksi turmush qiymatini qanday o‘lchaydi va nima uchun inflyatsiya muhim.
inflation-cpi.body:
Inflyatsiya — umumiy narx darajasining barqaror o‘sishi. U odatda iste’mol narxlari indeksi (INI) bilan o‘lchanadi; bu indeks oddiy uy xo‘jaligi sotib oladigan qat’iy tovar va xizmatlar savatining narxini kuzatadi. t yildagi INI = (t yildagi savat narxi ÷ bazaviy yildagi narx) × 100, inflyatsiya darajasi esa INI ning foiz o‘zgarishi: (hozirgi INI − bir yil oldingi INI) ÷ bir yil oldingi INI.

Misol: savat bazaviy yilda 4 000 000 so‘m, bir yildan keyin 4 400 000 so‘m turadi. INI 100 dan 110 ga ko‘tariladi, demak inflyatsiya 10%. Ish haqi 7% ga oshgan ishchining real ish haqi taxminan 3% ga kamaygan. Fisher munosabati stavkalarni xuddi shunday bog‘laydi: real foiz stavkasi ≈ nominal foiz stavkasi − kutilayotgan inflyatsiya.

INI haqiqiy turmush qiymati o‘sishini oshirib ko‘rsatishga moyil, sababi almashtirish xatoligi (uy xo‘jaliklari arzonroq tovarlarga o‘tadi), yangi mahsulotlar va sifat yaxshilanishidir. Bazaviy inflyatsiya asosiy tendensiyani ko‘rsatish uchun o‘zgaruvchan oziq-ovqat va energiya narxlarini chiqarib tashlaydi. Inflyatsiya yuqori yoki oldindan aytib bo‘lmaydigan bo‘lsa, qimmatga tushadi: u boylikni jamg‘aruvchilardan qarz oluvchilarga qayta taqsimlaydi, narx signallarini buzadi va noaniqlikni oshiradi. Deflyatsiya, ya’ni narx darajasining pasayishi ham xavfli, chunki u qarzning real yukini oshiradi.

Asosiy xulosa: inflyatsiya = narx indeksining foiz o‘zgarishi. Nominal qiymatlarni har doim inflyatsiyani ayirish orqali real qiymatlarga aylantiring.

unemployment.title: Ishsizlik va mehnat bozori
unemployment.summary: Ishsizlik qanday o‘lchanadi hamda friksion, tarkibiy va davriy ishsizlik o‘rtasidagi farq.
unemployment.body:
Ishchi kuchi — ishlayotgan yoki faol ish qidirayotgan barcha odamlar. Ishsizlik darajasi = ishsizlar ÷ ishchi kuchi × 100. Ish qidirishni to‘xtatgan odamlar (umidsizlangan ishchilar) ishchi kuchiga kiritilmaydi, shuning uchun rasmiy daraja mehnat bozorining zaifligini kamaytirib ko‘rsatishi mumkin. Ishchi kuchining ishtirok darajasi = ishchi kuchi ÷ mehnatga layoqatli yoshdagi aholi.

Iqtisodchilar ishsizlikning uch turini ajratadi. Friksion ishsizlik ishchilar va ish o‘rinlarini moslashtirish uchun ketadigan vaqtdan kelib chiqadi, masalan birinchi ishini qidirayotgan bitiruvchi. Tarkibiy ishsizlik ishchilarning ko‘nikmalari yoki joylashuvi mavjud ish o‘rinlariga mos kelmaganda yuzaga keladi, masalan avtomatlashtirish yoki tarmoq inqirozidan keyin. Davriy ishsizlik tanazzul paytida talab pasayganda oshadi. Tabiiy ishsizlik darajasi friksion va tarkibiy ishsizlik yig‘indisi; haqiqiy ishsizlik tabiiy darajaga teng bo‘lganda iqtisodiyot potensial ishlab chiqarish darajasida bo‘ladi.

Okun qonuni ishlab chiqarish va ish o‘rinlari o‘rtasidagi bog‘liqlikni umumlashtiradi: ko‘plab iqtisodiyotlarda tabiiy darajadan yuqori har 1 foiz punkt ishsizlik ishlab chiqarishning potensialdan taxminan 2% past bo‘lishiga to‘g‘ri keladi. Misol: 1 000 kishi ishlayotgan va 80 kishi ish qidirayotgan bo‘lsa, ishchi kuchi 1 080 kishi, ishsizlik darajasi esa 80 ÷ 1 080 ≈ 7,4%.

Asosiy xulosa: ishsizlik darajasi = ishsizlar ÷ ishchi kuchi. Talab tomonidagi barqarorlashtirish siyosatining nishoni faqat davriy ishsizlikdir; tarkibiy ishsizlik uchun kasbiy tayyorgarlik va mehnat bozori islohotlari kerak.

aggregate-demand.title: Yalpi talab va multiplikator
aggregate-demand.summary: Iqtisodiyotdagi umumiy xarajatlar, uni nima siljitadi va nima uchun xarajatlarning dastlabki o‘zgarishi kuchayadi.
aggregate-demand.body:
Yalpi talab (YaT) — har bir narx darajasida mamlakat mahsulotiga rejalashtirilgan umumiy xarajat: YaT = C + I + G + NX. YaT egri chizig‘i pastga qiyalanadi, chunki narx darajasi pasaysa, pul va boylikning real qiymati oshadi, foiz stavkalari pasayadi va eksport arzonlashadi. Iste’molchi yoki biznes ishonchi o‘zgarganda, davlat xarajatlari yoki soliqlar o‘zgarganda, markaziy bank foiz stavkalarini o‘zgartirganda yoki tashqi talab o‘zgarganda YaT siljiydi.

Xarajatlarning dastlabki o‘zgarishi kuchayadi, chunki bir kishining xarajati boshqasining daromadidir. Agar uy xo‘jaliklari har bir qo‘shimcha so‘mning MPC (iste’molga chekli moyillik) qismini sarflasa, xarajatlar multiplikatori 1 ÷ (1 − MPC) ga teng. MPC = 0,8 bo‘lganda multiplikator 5 ga teng: oddiy yopiq iqtisodiyotda davlat investitsiyalarining 10 trillion so‘mga oshishi YaIMni 50 trillion so‘mgacha oshirishi mumkin. Amalda multiplikatorlar ancha kichik, chunki qo‘shimcha daromadning bir qismi soliqqa tortiladi, jamg‘ariladi yoki importga sarflanadi, foiz stavkalari ham oshishi mumkin.

Asosiy xulosa: YaT = C + I + G + NX, xarajatlar o‘zgarishi esa 1 ÷ (1 − MPC) multiplikatori orqali iqtisodiyot bo‘ylab tarqaladi. Haqiqiy multiplikatorlarni soliqlar, import va jamg‘arma kamaytiradi.

aggregate-supply.title: Qisqa va uzoq muddatli yalpi taklif
aggregate-supply.summary: Nima uchun ishlab chiqarish qisqa muddatda potensialdan chetga chiqishi, ammo uzoq muddatda unga qaytishi mumkin.
aggregate-supply.body:
Yalpi taklif (YaTk) firmalar har bir narx darajasida qancha mahsulot ishlab chiqarishini ko‘rsatadi. Uzoq muddatda ishlab chiqarish narx darajasi bilan emas, balki real resurslar (mehnat, kapital, texnologiya va institutlar) bilan belgilanadi, shuning uchun uzoq muddatli yalpi taklif (UMYaTk) egri chizig‘i potensial ishlab chiqarish Y* da vertikal bo‘ladi. UMYaTk ning o‘sishi o‘nlab yillar davomida turmush darajasini oshiradi.

Qisqa muddatda ko‘plab ish haqi va narxlar qotib qolgan bo‘ladi: shartnomalar va narxnomalar har hafta qayta yozilmaydi. Narx darajasi kutilmaganda oshsa, firmalarning sotish narxlari xarajatlaridan tezroq oshadi, shuning uchun ular ko‘proq ishlab chiqaradi. Shu sababli qisqa muddatli yalpi taklif (QMYaTk) egri chizig‘i yuqoriga qiyalanadi. Resurs xarajatlari oshganda, masalan neft narxi zarbasi yoki ish haqining keskin oshishidan keyin, QMYaTk chapga, xarajatlar pasayganda yoki unumdorlik oshganda o‘ngga siljiydi.

YaT va QMYaTk kesishmasi qisqa muddatli ishlab chiqarish va narx darajasini beradi. Ishlab chiqarish Y* dan past bo‘lsa, yuqori ishsizlik bilan tanazzul uzilishi, Y* dan yuqori bo‘lsa, inflyatsion uzilish yuzaga keladi. Vaqt o‘tishi bilan ish haqi va narxlar moslashadi va QMYaTk iqtisodiyot Y* ga qaytguncha siljiydi. Taklif zarbasi ayniqsa qiyin, chunki u bir vaqtning o‘zida narxlarni oshiradi va ishlab chiqarishni kamaytiradi — bu stagflyatsiya deb ataladi.

Asosiy xulosa: uzoq muddatda ishlab chiqarish potensial darajada qat’iy va faqat narx darajasi moslashadi; qisqa muddatda qotib qolgan narxlar talab va xarajat zarbalariga ishlab chiqarishni o‘zgartirish imkonini beradi.

fiscal-policy.title: Fiskal siyosat va davlat qarzi
fiscal-policy.summary: Davlat xarajatlari va soliqqa tortish talabni qanday barqarorlashtiradi hamda taqchillik va qarz qo‘yadigan cheklovlar.
fiscal-policy.body:
Fiskal siyosat — iqtisodiyotga ta’sir qilish uchun davlat xarajatlari va soliqlardan foydalanish. Rag‘batlantiruvchi fiskal siyosat (xarajatlarni oshirish yoki soliqlarni kamaytirish) tanazzul uzilishini yopish uchun YaT ni o‘ngga siljitadi; cheklovchi siyosat (xarajatlarni kamaytirish yoki soliqlarni oshirish) qizib ketgan iqtisodiyotni sovutish uchun YaT ni chapga siljitadi. Ishsizlik nafaqalari va progressiv daromad solig‘i kabi avtomatik barqarorlashtirgichlar yangi qonunlarsiz ishlaydi: ular biznes sikli bilan birga oshadi yoki kamayadi va daromad tebranishlarini yumshatadi.

Byudjet taqchilligi yil davomida xarajatlar daromaddan oshganda yuzaga keladi; davlat qarzi esa o‘tgan taqchilliklarning to‘plangan miqdoridir. Barqarorlik uchun qarzning YaIMga nisbati muhim. Birlamchi balans (foiz to‘lovlarini hisobga olmagan byudjet balansi) qarz bo‘yicha foiz stavkasi bilan YaIM o‘sish sur’ati o‘rtasidagi farqqa nisbatan yetarlicha katta bo‘lsa, bu nisbat barqaror qoladi. Agar foiz stavkalari o‘sishdan ancha yuqori bo‘lsa, mamlakat nisbatni bir xil darajada ushlab turish uchungina birlamchi profitsitga ega bo‘lishi kerak.

Fiskal siyosatning cheklovlari bor. Qarorlar va xarajatlar vaqt talab qiladi (amalga oshirishdagi kechikishlar), davlatning qo‘shimcha qarz olishi foiz stavkalarini oshirib, xususiy investitsiyalarni siqib chiqarishi mumkin, katta qarzlar esa keyingi inqirozga javob berish imkoniyatini kamaytiradi. Kichik ochiq iqtisodiyotlarda har qanday rag‘batlantirishning bir qismi import orqali chet elga oqib ketadi.

Asosiy xulosa: fiskal siyosat xarajatlar va soliqlar orqali yalpi talabni siljitadi. Taqchilliklar barqarorligini baholash uchun qarzning YaIMga nisbatini hamda foiz stavkalari va o‘sish o‘rtasidagi farqni kuzating.

functions-of-money.title: Pul nima va u qanday vazifalarni bajaradi
functions-of-money.summary: Pul ayirboshlash vositasi, hisob birligi va qiymat saqlash vositasi sifatida hamda pul massasi qanday o‘lchanadi.
functions-of-money.body:
Pul — to‘lov sifatida keng qabul qilinadigan har qanday aktiv. U uchta vazifani bajaradi. Ayirboshlash vositasi sifatida u barter talab qiladigan ehtiyojlarning ikki tomonlama mos kelishi zaruratini yo‘q qiladi. Hisob birligi sifatida u narxlar, shartnomalar va hisoblar uchun umumiy o‘lchov beradi. Qiymat saqlash vositasi sifatida u odamlarga xarid qobiliyatini kelajakka ko‘chirish imkonini beradi, garchi inflyatsiya bu vazifani zaiflashtirsa ham.

Zamonaviy pul — fiat pul: uning qiymati oltin bilan ta’minlangani uchun emas, balki davlat uni qonuniy to‘lov vositasi deb e’lon qilgani va odamlar unga ishongani uchun mavjud. Pulning katta qismi naqd pul emas, balki bank depozitlaridir. Markaziy banklar pul massasini agregatlar bilan o‘lchaydi: M0 yoki pul bazasi (naqd pul va banklarning markaziy bankdagi zaxiralari), M1 (muomaladagi naqd pul va talab qilib olinguncha depozitlar) va M2 (M1 hamda jamg‘arma va muddatli depozitlar). Depozitlarning ko‘p qismi xorijiy valyutada bo‘lgan iqtisodiyotlarda tahlilchilar dollarlashuvni, ya’ni depozit va kreditlarning dollardagi ulushini ham kuzatadi, chunki u markaziy bank nazoratini zaiflashtiradi.

Asosiy xulosa: pul nimadan yasalgani bilan emas, balki qanday vazifa bajarishi bilan belgilanadi. Pul massasining katta qismi jismoniy naqd puldan emas, bank depozitlaridan iborat.

banks-money-creation.title: Banklar pulni qanday yaratadi
banks-money-creation.summary: Qisman zaxiralash tizimi, pul multiplikatori va nima uchun bank kreditlari pul massasini kengaytiradi.
banks-money-creation.body:
Tijorat banklari depozitlarning faqat bir qismini zaxira sifatida saqlaydi va qolganini kreditga beradi. Bank kredit berganda, qarz oluvchining hisobiga yangi depozit yozadi va bu depozit yangi puldir. Qarz oluvchi uni sarflaganda, pul boshqa bankka tushadi va u ham uning bir qismini yana kreditga berishi mumkin.

Oddiy pul multiplikatori maksimal kengayishni ko‘rsatadi: pul multiplikatori = 1 ÷ zaxira normasi. 10% majburiy zaxira normasida qo‘shimcha 1 milliard so‘m zaxira 10 milliard so‘mgacha depozitni ta’minlashi mumkin. Bank balansi bu mantiqni ko‘rsatadi: aktivlar (zaxiralar, kreditlar, qimmatli qog‘ozlar) = majburiyatlar (depozitlar, qarzlar) + o‘z kapitali.

Haqiqatda multiplikator mexanik tarzda ishlamaydi. Banklar kreditga layoqatli qarz oluvchilarni topganda va kredit berish foydali bo‘lganda kredit beradi, ularni zaxiralardan ko‘ra ko‘proq kapital talablari va risk cheklaydi. Uy xo‘jaliklari ham bir oz naqd pul saqlaydi, bu multiplikatorni kamaytiradi. Shu sababli zamonaviy markaziy banklar zaxiralar miqdorini to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri nazorat qilishga urinish o‘rniga pul narxini (foiz stavkasini) boshqaradi.

Asosiy xulosa: bank kreditlari depozitlarni yaratadi, depozitlar esa puldir. 1 ÷ zaxira normasi multiplikatori aniq bashorat emas, balki yuqori chegaradir.

quantity-theory.title: Pul, narxlar va miqdoriy nazariya
quantity-theory.summary: Ayirboshlash tenglamasi uzoq muddatda pul massasi o‘sishini inflyatsiya bilan bog‘laydi.
quantity-theory.body:
Ayirboshlash tenglamasi — ayniyat: M × V = P × Y, bu yerda M — pul massasi, V — pul aylanish tezligi (bir birlik pul yiliga necha marta sarflanishi), P — narx darajasi, Y — real ishlab chiqarish. P × Y nominal YaIMga teng.

Miqdoriy nazariya ikkita farazni qo‘shadi: aylanish tezligi nisbatan barqaror, uzoq muddatda real ishlab chiqarish esa real omillar bilan belgilanadi. O‘sish sur’atlarida ayniyat quyidagicha bo‘ladi: pul massasi o‘sishi + aylanish tezligi o‘sishi ≈ inflyatsiya + real YaIM o‘sishi. V barqaror bo‘lsa, inflyatsiya ≈ pul massasi o‘sishi − real ishlab chiqarish o‘sishi. Misol: pul massasi yiliga 20% ga, real YaIM esa 5% ga o‘ssa, uzoq muddatli inflyatsiya taxminan 15% atrofida bo‘ladi.

Dalillar buni uzoq davrlarda va turli mamlakatlarda qat’iy tasdiqlaydi: juda yuqori inflyatsiya yoki giperinflyatsiyaning har bir holati pul massasining tez o‘sishi bilan kechgan, ko‘pincha davlat byudjeti taqchilligini moliyalashtirish uchun. Qisqa muddatda bog‘liqlik zaif, chunki aylanish tezligi foiz stavkalari, moliyaviy innovatsiyalar va ishonch bilan birga o‘zgaradi, ishlab chiqarish esa potensialdan chetga chiqishi mumkin. Shu sababli markaziy banklar qisqa muddatli boshqaruv uchun foiz stavkalariga e’tibor qaratadi, vaqt o‘tishi bilan esa pul massasi o‘sishini past inflyatsiyaga mos holda ushlab turadi.

Asosiy xulosa: MV = PY. Uzoq muddatda barqaror inflyatsiya pul massasining real ishlab chiqarishdan tezroq o‘sishi bilan bog‘liq.

central-bank-tools.title: Markaziy bank maqsadlari va vositalari
central-bank-tools.summary: Narx barqarorligi mandati, asosiy stavka, ochiq bozor operatsiyalari va majburiy zaxira talablari.
central-bank-tools.body:
Ko‘pchilik markaziy banklarning asosiy maqsadi narx barqarorligi bo‘lib, u ko‘pincha raqamli inflyatsiya maqsadi sifatida belgilanadi; ko‘plari bandlik va moliyaviy barqarorlikni ham hisobga oladi. Inflyatsiyani targetlash rejimida bank o‘z maqsadini e’lon qiladi, qarorlarini tushuntiradi va inflyatsiyaning bir-ikki yillik ufqda maqsadga qaytishi bo‘yicha baholanadi. O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Markaziy banki ham, boshqa ko‘plab banklar kabi, siyosatini asosan asosiy stavka orqali yetkazadi.

Asosiy vosita — siyosiy foiz stavkasi, ya’ni markaziy bank tijorat banklariga kredit beradigan yoki ulardan depozit qabul qiladigan stavka. Qisqa muddatli bozor stavkalarini asosiy stavkaga yaqin ushlab turish uchun markaziy bank ochiq bozor operatsiyalaridan (davlat qimmatli qog‘ozlarini sotib olish yoki sotish, repo va teskari repo operatsiyalari) hamda doimiy imkoniyatlar koridoridan foydalanadi: yuqori chegara sifatida overnayt kredit stavkasi va quyi chegara sifatida depozit stavkasi.

Boshqa vositalar qatoriga majburiy zaxira talablari (banklar markaziy bankda saqlashi shart bo‘lgan depozitlar ulushi), valyuta intervensiyalari va kredit summasining garov qiymatiga nisbatini cheklash kabi makroprudensial qoidalar kiradi. Asosiy stavkani oshirish cheklovchi (qat’iylashtirish), pasaytirish esa rag‘batlantiruvchi (yumshatish) siyosatdir.

Asosiy xulosa: zamonaviy markaziy banklar qisqa muddatli foiz stavkasini boshqaradi va bozor stavkalari asosiy stavkaga ergashishi uchun ochiq bozor operatsiyalari hamda foiz koridoridan foydalanadi.

transmission-mechanism.title: Pul-kredit siyosatining uzatish mexanizmi
transmission-mechanism.summary: Asosiy stavka o‘zgarishi xarajatlar, ishlab chiqarish va inflyatsiyaga ta’sir qiladigan kanallar.
transmission-mechanism.body:
Uzatish mexanizmi asosiy stavka o‘zgarishi real iqtisodiyotga qanday yetib borishini tavsiflaydi. Faraz qilaylik, markaziy bank stavkani 1 foiz punktga oshirdi. Avval banklararo va qisqa muddatli bozor stavkalari oshadi, banklar kredit va depozitlar bo‘yicha stavkalarni ko‘taradi (foiz stavkasi kanali). Uy-joy, avtomobil va biznes investitsiyalari uchun qarz olish qimmatlashadi, jamg‘arish esa jozibadorroq bo‘ladi, shuning uchun xarajatlar kamayadi.

Boshqa kanallar buni kuchaytiradi. Yuqori ichki stavkalar kapitalni jalb qiladi va milliy valyutani mustahkamlashga moyil bo‘ladi, bu importni arzonlashtirib, inflyatsiyani bevosita pasaytiradi (valyuta kursi kanali), ayniqsa iste’mol qilinadigan narsalarning katta qismini import qiladigan iqtisodiyotlarda. Obligatsiyalar, aksiyalar va ko‘chmas mulk kabi aktivlar narxi tushadi, boylik va garov qiymati kamayadi (aktivlar narxi va kredit kanallari). Ehtimol, eng muhimi, ishonchli markaziy bank kutishlarni shakllantiradi: firmalar va ishchilar inflyatsiya pasayishiga ishonsa, ular pastroq narxlar va ish haqi talablarini belgilaydi.

Uzatish uzoq va o‘zgaruvchan kechikishlar bilan ishlaydi. Ishlab chiqarishga ta’sir odatda taxminan bir yildan keyin, inflyatsiyaga esa bir-ikki yildan keyin eng yuqori darajaga yetadi, shuning uchun markaziy banklar joriy inflyatsiyaga emas, prognozlarga qarab harakat qilishi kerak. Kreditlarning ko‘p qismi xorijiy valyutada bo‘lsa, kreditning katta qismi davlat tomonidan imtiyozli stavkalarda yo‘naltirilsa yoki moliya bozorlari sayoz bo‘lsa, uzatish zaifroq bo‘ladi.

Asosiy xulosa: stavka o‘zgarishlari qarz olish xarajatlari, valyuta kursi, aktivlar narxi, kredit va kutishlar orqali bir-ikki yillik kechikish bilan ta’sir qiladi. Ishonchlilik har bir kanalni kuchaytiradi.

taylor-rule-phillips.title: Fillips egri chizig‘i va Teylor qoidasi
taylor-rule-phillips.summary: Inflyatsiya va ishsizlik o‘rtasidagi qisqa muddatli bog‘liqlik hamda foiz stavkasini belgilashning oddiy qoidasi.
taylor-rule-phillips.body:
Fillips egri chizig‘i qisqa muddatli bog‘liqlikni tavsiflaydi: ishsizlik tabiiy darajadan past bo‘lsa, mehnat bozori tarang bo‘ladi va inflyatsiya oshishga moyil bo‘ladi; ishsizlik yuqori bo‘lsa, inflyatsiya pasayishga moyil bo‘ladi. Zamonaviy, kutishlar bilan kengaytirilgan ko‘rinishi: π = πᵉ − β(u − uₙ), bu yerda πᵉ — kutilayotgan inflyatsiya. 1970-yillarning asosiy saboqi shuki, bu bog‘liqlik faqat vaqtinchalik: ishsizlikni doimiy ravishda tabiiy darajadan past ushlab turishga urinish faqat kutilayotgan inflyatsiyani oshiradi, shuning uchun uzoq muddatda Fillips egri chizig‘i vertikal bo‘ladi.

Teylor qoidasi markaziy bank asosiy stavkani qanday belgilashi mumkinligini umumlashtiradi: i = r* + π + 0,5 × (π − π*) + 0,5 × (ishlab chiqarish uzilishi). Bu yerda r* — neytral real foiz stavkasi, π — joriy inflyatsiya, π* — maqsad, ishlab chiqarish uzilishi esa haqiqiy va potensial ishlab chiqarish o‘rtasidagi foiz farqi. Misol: r* = 2%, π = 8%, π* = 5% va ishlab chiqarish uzilishi +1% bo‘lsa, qoida i = 2 + 8 + 1,5 + 0,5 = 12% ni taklif qiladi.

Qoida Teylor tamoyilini o‘zida mujassam etadi: inflyatsiya 1 punktga oshsa, nominal stavka 1 punktdan ko‘proq oshishi kerak, shunda real foiz stavkasi ko‘tariladi va talab sovuydi. Markaziy banklar qoidaga mexanik tarzda amal qilmaydi, chunki r* va potensial ishlab chiqarish noaniq, ammo u siyosat qat’iy yoki yumshoq ekanini baholash uchun foydali andozadir.

Asosiy xulosa: inflyatsiya va ishsizlik o‘rtasida qisqa muddatli, lekin uzoq muddatli bo‘lmagan bog‘liqlik mavjud. Teylor qoidasiga ko‘ra stavkalar inflyatsiyaga nisbatan birdan-birga nisbatdan ko‘proq oshishi kerak.

unconventional-policy.title: Noan’anaviy siyosat va ishonchlilik
unconventional-policy.summary: Miqdoriy yumshatish, kelajak siyosati bo‘yicha yo‘l-yo‘riq va nima uchun markaziy bank mustaqilligi muhim.
unconventional-policy.body:
Asosiy stavkalar nolga yaqinlashganda, markaziy banklar ularni yanada ko‘p pasaytira olmaydi; bu samarali quyi chegara deyiladi. 2008-yilgi moliyaviy inqiroz va 2020-yilgi pandemiya paytida bir qancha markaziy banklar noan’anaviy vositalardan foydalandi. Miqdoriy yumshatish (QE) — uzoq muddatli davlat obligatsiyalari va boshqa aktivlarni katta hajmda sotib olish bo‘lib, u zaxiralarni yaratadi va uzoq muddatli foiz stavkalarini pasaytiradi. Kelajak siyosati bo‘yicha yo‘l-yo‘riq (forward guidance) — stavkalarni ma’lum muddat yoki shartlar bajarilguncha past ushlab turish bo‘yicha ochiq majburiyat bo‘lib, u kelajakdagi stavkalar bo‘yicha kutishlarni va shu orqali bugungi uzoq muddatli stavkalarni pasaytiradi.

Ishonchlilik barcha pul-kredit siyosatining poydevoridir. Agar odamlar markaziy bank yuqori inflyatsiyaga toqat qiladi deb kutsa, ular bu kutishni ish haqi va narxlarga kiritadi va inflyatsiya o‘z-o‘zini amalga oshiradigan bo‘ladi. Markaziy bank mustaqilligi, aniq mandat va shaffof kommunikatsiya (e’lon qilingan maqsadlar, prognozlar va qarorlar tushuntirishlari) kutishlarni barqarorlashtirishni osonlashtiradi. Qarama-qarshi holat — fiskal ustunlik: markaziy bank davlat byudjeti taqchilligini moliyalashtirishga majburlanganda, pul massasi o‘sishi va inflyatsiya ortidan keladi.

Misol: o‘z maqsadiga qayta-qayta erishgan markaziy bank yoqilg‘i narxining oshishi kabi vaqtinchalik narx zarbasining barqaror inflyatsiyaga aylanishini stavkaning mo‘tadil o‘zgarishi bilan to‘xtata oladi. Tarixi yomon bo‘lgan bank xuddi shu natijaga erishish uchun stavkani ancha ko‘proq oshirishi kerak bo‘lishi mumkin.

Asosiy xulosa: quyi chegarada markaziy banklar aktivlarni sotib olish va kelajakdagi stavkalar bo‘yicha yo‘l-yo‘riqdan foydalanadi. Ishonchlilik va mustaqillik har qanday siyosiy qadam qanchalik natija berishini belgilaydi.

topics.title: Calculus for Economics & Optimization
topics.description: The derivative as the language of marginal analysis: differentiate cost, revenue and utility functions, find maxima and minima, and solve constrained optimization problems with Lagrange multipliers.

modules.title: Derivatives and marginal analysis
modules.summary: What a derivative measures, how to compute one, and how economists read derivatives as marginal quantities.

lessons.title: The derivative as a rate of change
lessons.summary: From the slope of a secant line to the instantaneous rate of change.
lessons.body:
The derivative measures how fast a function changes. The average rate of change of f between x and x + h is the slope of the secant line, [f(x + h) − f(x)] ÷ h. Letting h shrink toward zero gives the instantaneous rate of change, which is the derivative: f′(x) = lim (h → 0) [f(x + h) − f(x)] ÷ h. Geometrically, f′(x) is the slope of the tangent line at x.

Example: for f(x) = x², [ (x + h)² − x² ] ÷ h = (2xh + h²) ÷ h = 2x + h, which tends to 2x as h → 0. So f′(x) = 2x, and at x = 3 the function is rising at a rate of 6 units of output per unit of input.

The sign of the derivative tells you direction: f′(x) > 0 means f is increasing, f′(x) < 0 means it is decreasing, and f′(x) = 0 marks a possible peak or trough. A function must be continuous to be differentiable, but continuity is not enough: |x| is continuous at 0 but has a corner there, so no single tangent slope exists.

Key takeaway: the derivative is the limit of average rates of change. Its sign shows whether a function is rising or falling, and zeros of the derivative are candidates for optima.

lessons.title: Rules of differentiation
lessons.summary: Power, product, quotient and chain rules, plus derivatives of exponentials and logarithms.
lessons.body:
Computing every derivative from the limit definition is slow, so we use rules. Power rule: d/dx xⁿ = n·xⁿ⁻¹, so d/dx 3x⁴ = 12x³ and d/dx √x = ½x^(−½). Constants vanish, and derivatives of sums are sums of derivatives. Product rule: (uv)′ = u′v + uv′. Quotient rule: (u ÷ v)′ = (u′v − uv′) ÷ v². Chain rule for composite functions: d/dx f(g(x)) = f′(g(x))·g′(x).

Exponentials and logarithms appear constantly in economics: d/dx eˣ = eˣ, d/dx e^(kx) = k·e^(kx) and d/dx ln x = 1 ÷ x. Worked examples: d/dx (x²eˣ) = 2xeˣ + x²eˣ by the product rule; d/dx (1 + 2x)⁵ = 5(1 + 2x)⁴ × 2 = 10(1 + 2x)⁴ by the chain rule; d/dx ln(5x² + 1) = 10x ÷ (5x² + 1).

A useful application is growth rates. If a variable grows as y(t) = y₀e^(gt), then d/dt ln y = g, the continuous growth rate. More generally, the growth rate of a product is the sum of growth rates, and the growth rate of a ratio is the difference: real GDP growth ≈ nominal GDP growth − inflation follows directly from differentiating logarithms.

Key takeaway: master the power, product, quotient and chain rules and the derivatives of eˣ and ln x; together they handle almost every function in introductory economics.

lessons.title: Marginal cost and marginal revenue as derivatives
lessons.summary: Why “marginal” in economics means “derivative” in calculus.
lessons.body:
In economics, “marginal” means the change in a total from one more unit. In calculus terms, it is the derivative. If C(q) is total cost, marginal cost is MC(q) = C′(q). If R(q) is total revenue, marginal revenue is MR(q) = R′(q), and marginal profit is π′(q) = R′(q) − C′(q).

Example: C(q) = 5,000 + 40q + 0.5q². Then MC(q) = 40 + q, so at q = 100 the marginal cost is 140. The exact cost of the 101st unit is C(101) − C(100) = 40 + 0.5 × (101² − 100²) = 140.5, very close to the derivative. The derivative is a linear approximation: ΔC ≈ C′(q) × Δq.

For revenue, suppose demand is P = 200 − 2q. Then R(q) = 200q − 2q² and MR(q) = 200 − 4q. At q = 30, MR = 80 while the price is 140: selling one more unit adds less than its price because the firm must lower the price on all units. MR is zero at q = 50, where total revenue is at its peak, and that is also the point of unit elasticity on the demand curve.

Average and marginal are linked: average cost AC = C(q) ÷ q is falling whenever MC < AC and rising whenever MC > AC, so MC crosses AC at its minimum.

Key takeaway: marginal cost, revenue and profit are derivatives of the corresponding totals, and the derivative gives a good approximation of the effect of one more unit.

lessons.title: Elasticity with derivatives
lessons.summary: Point elasticity, constant-elasticity functions and the link between elasticity and revenue.
lessons.body:
Calculus turns elasticity into a precise point measure: E = (dQ/dP) × (P ÷ Q). It is the percentage change in quantity for a 1% change in price at a specific point on the demand curve. Equivalently, E = d(ln Q) ÷ d(ln P), the slope of the demand curve on log-log axes.

Example with linear demand: Q = 200 − 4P. At P = 20, Q = 120 and dQ/dP = −4, so E = −4 × 20 ÷ 120 ≈ −0.67 (inelastic). At P = 35, Q = 60 and E = −4 × 35 ÷ 60 ≈ −2.33 (elastic). Elasticity changes along a straight-line demand curve even though its slope is constant.

Constant-elasticity demand has the form Q = A·P^(−ε). Taking logarithms gives ln Q = ln A − ε ln P, so the elasticity is −ε everywhere. This form is widely used in empirical work because a log-log regression estimates the elasticity directly.

Calculus also proves the revenue rule. With R = P·Q(P), dR/dP = Q + P·dQ/dP = Q(1 + E). If E is between −1 and 0, raising price increases revenue; if E < −1, raising price reduces it. In terms of quantity, MR = P(1 + 1 ÷ E), which leads directly to the monopoly markup rule (P − MC) ÷ P = −1 ÷ E.

Key takeaway: point elasticity is (dQ/dP)(P/Q). The formula dR/dP = Q(1 + E) shows exactly when a price increase raises revenue.

modules.title: Optimization in one variable
modules.summary: Find and classify maxima and minima, then apply them to profit, cost and inventory decisions.

lessons.title: Critical points and the second-derivative test
lessons.summary: Locate candidates for maxima and minima, then use concavity to classify them.
lessons.body:
A critical point is where f′(x) = 0 or where f′ does not exist. Every local maximum or minimum of a differentiable function on an open interval occurs at a critical point (the first-order condition), but not every critical point is an optimum: f(x) = x³ has f′(0) = 0 with no peak or trough.

To classify, use the second derivative. If f′(c) = 0 and f″(c) < 0, the function is concave down near c and c is a local maximum. If f″(c) > 0, it is concave up and c is a local minimum. If f″(c) = 0 the test is inconclusive, and you check the sign of f′ on each side instead (the first-derivative test).

Example: f(x) = x³ − 6x² + 9x + 1. Then f′(x) = 3x² − 12x + 9 = 3(x − 1)(x − 3), with critical points x = 1 and x = 3. Since f″(x) = 6x − 12, f″(1) = −6 < 0 gives a local maximum f(1) = 5, and f″(3) = 6 > 0 gives a local minimum f(3) = 1.

On a closed interval [a, b], the global maximum and minimum are found by comparing f at all critical points and at the endpoints a and b. In economics, concavity has meaning: a concave profit function guarantees that a critical point is the global maximum.

Key takeaway: set f′(x) = 0 to find candidates, use f″ to classify them, and check endpoints when the domain is restricted.

lessons.title: Profit maximization
lessons.summary: Derive the rule MR = MC from calculus and apply it to a firm with market power.
lessons.body:
Profit is revenue minus cost: π(q) = R(q) − C(q). The first-order condition π′(q) = 0 gives R′(q) = C′(q), the famous rule marginal revenue = marginal cost. The second-order condition π″(q) < 0, or R″(q) < C″(q), confirms a maximum: marginal cost must cut marginal revenue from below.

Example: a firm faces demand P = 140 − 2q and has cost C(q) = 100 + 20q + q². Revenue is R = 140q − 2q², so MR = 140 − 4q. Marginal cost is MC = 20 + 2q. Setting 140 − 4q = 20 + 2q gives 6q = 120, so q* = 20 and the price is P = 140 − 40 = 100. Profit is R − C = 2,000 − (100 + 400 + 400) = 1,100. Since π″(q) = −4 − 2 = −6 < 0, this is a maximum.

Two refinements matter in practice. First, a firm should produce at all only if price covers average variable cost; otherwise the best output is zero. Second, fixed costs do not affect q*: changing the 100 in C(q) changes profit but not the optimal quantity, because fixed costs disappear when you differentiate.

Key takeaway: maximize profit by solving MR = MC, confirm with π″ < 0, and then check that producing beats shutting down. Fixed costs never change the optimal quantity.

lessons.title: Cost minimization and the economic order quantity
lessons.summary: Balance ordering costs against holding costs to find the cheapest inventory policy.
lessons.body:
Many business problems trade off two costs that move in opposite directions. Inventory is a classic case. Ordering often means paying a fixed cost S per order many times a year; ordering rarely means holding a large stock, which costs H per unit per year in storage, insurance and tied-up cash.

If annual demand is D and each order is of size Q, the number of orders is D ÷ Q and the average stock is Q ÷ 2. Total annual cost is TC(Q) = (D ÷ Q)·S + (Q ÷ 2)·H. Differentiating: TC′(Q) = −DS ÷ Q² + H ÷ 2. Setting this to zero gives the economic order quantity Q* = √(2DS ÷ H). The second derivative 2DS ÷ Q³ is positive, so this is a minimum.

Example: a shop sells D = 10,000 units a year, each order costs S = 200,000 UZS in delivery and paperwork, and holding one unit for a year costs H = 4,000 UZS. Then Q* = √(2 × 10,000 × 200,000 ÷ 4,000) = √1,000,000 = 1,000 units, so the shop orders 10 times a year. At the optimum, annual ordering cost (2,000,000 UZS) exactly equals annual holding cost (2,000,000 UZS).

The same logic, setting the derivative of total cost to zero, finds the output that minimizes average cost, the best batch size in a factory, or the cash balance that balances interest lost against withdrawal fees.

Key takeaway: when two costs pull in opposite directions, write total cost as a function of the decision, differentiate, and set the derivative to zero. For inventory, Q* = √(2DS/H).

modules.title: Multivariable and constrained optimization
modules.summary: Partial derivatives, optimization with several choice variables, and Lagrange multipliers for problems with constraints.

lessons.title: Partial derivatives and marginal products
lessons.summary: Differentiate with respect to one variable while holding the others fixed.
lessons.body:
Economic quantities usually depend on several variables: output depends on labor and capital, utility on several goods. The partial derivative ∂f/∂x measures how f changes when x changes and every other variable is held constant, which is the formal version of the economist's “other things equal”. To compute it, treat the other variables as constants and differentiate as usual.

Example: the Cobb-Douglas production function Q = 10·L^0.5·K^0.5. The marginal product of labor is MPL = ∂Q/∂L = 5·L^(−0.5)·K^0.5, and the marginal product of capital is MPK = ∂Q/∂K = 5·L^0.5·K^(−0.5). With L = 25 and K = 100, output is Q = 10 × 5 × 10 = 500, MPL = 5 × 0.2 × 10 = 10 and MPK = 5 × 5 × 0.1 = 2.5. Each partial derivative falls as its own input rises, which is diminishing marginal returns.

Second partials give more information. ∂²Q/∂L² < 0 confirms diminishing returns to labor, while the cross-partial ∂²Q/∂L∂K > 0 says capital makes labor more productive. The ratio MPL ÷ MPK is the marginal rate of technical substitution, the slope of an isoquant. The total differential dQ = MPL·dL + MPK·dK approximates the change in output when both inputs change at once.

Key takeaway: a partial derivative isolates the effect of one variable with the rest held fixed. Marginal products, marginal utilities and substitution rates are all partial derivatives or their ratios.

lessons.title: Unconstrained optimization with several variables
lessons.summary: Set every partial derivative to zero and check the second-order conditions; applied to price discrimination.
lessons.body:
To maximize or minimize f(x, y), the first-order conditions require every partial derivative to be zero: ∂f/∂x = 0 and ∂f/∂y = 0, meaning the gradient vector is zero. The second-order conditions use the Hessian matrix of second partials. For a maximum in two variables, you need fₓₓ < 0 and fₓₓ·f_yy − (fₓy)² > 0; for a minimum, fₓₓ > 0 and the same determinant positive. If the determinant is negative, the point is a saddle.

Example, third-degree price discrimination: a firm sells in two separate markets with demand P₁ = 100 − Q₁ and P₂ = 80 − 2Q₂ and a constant marginal cost of 20. Profit is π = (100 − Q₁)Q₁ + (80 − 2Q₂)Q₂ − 20(Q₁ + Q₂). Setting ∂π/∂Q₁ = 100 − 2Q₁ − 20 = 0 gives Q₁ = 40 and P₁ = 60. Setting ∂π/∂Q₂ = 80 − 4Q₂ − 20 = 0 gives Q₂ = 15 and P₂ = 50. The Hessian has entries −2 and −4 on the diagonal and 0 off it, so the determinant is 8 > 0 with πₓₓ < 0, confirming a maximum.

The result illustrates a general rule: the firm equalizes marginal revenue in each market with marginal cost (MR₁ = MR₂ = MC) and charges the higher price where demand is less elastic. At the optimum, elasticity is about −1.5 in market 1 and −1.67 in market 2, so market 1 pays more.

Key takeaway: set the gradient to zero, then check the Hessian. In multi-market pricing this delivers MR = MC in every market, with higher prices where demand is less elastic.

lessons.title: Lagrange multipliers: utility maximization
lessons.summary: Solve optimization problems subject to a budget or resource constraint.
lessons.body:
Many economic problems maximize something subject to a constraint: a consumer maximizes utility given a budget, a firm maximizes output given a cost limit. The Lagrange method handles this. To maximize f(x, y) subject to g(x, y) = c, form the Lagrangian ℒ = f(x, y) + λ[c − g(x, y)] and set all partial derivatives to zero: ∂ℒ/∂x = 0, ∂ℒ/∂y = 0 and ∂ℒ/∂λ = 0 (which just restates the constraint).

Example: maximize U = x^0.5·y^0.5 subject to 10x + 5y = 100. The conditions are 0.5·x^(−0.5)·y^0.5 = 10λ, 0.5·x^0.5·y^(−0.5) = 5λ, and 10x + 5y = 100. Dividing the first by the second gives y ÷ x = 2, so y = 2x. Substituting into the budget: 10x + 10x = 100, so x = 5 and y = 10. Utility is √50 ≈ 7.07.

The first two conditions together say MUx ÷ MUy = Px ÷ Py: the slope of the indifference curve equals the slope of the budget line, exactly the tangency condition from consumer theory. For Cobb-Douglas utility U = x^a·y^b, the solution always spends a share a ÷ (a + b) of income on x and b ÷ (a + b) on y, which is why the consumer above spent half the budget on each good.

Key takeaway: form ℒ = f + λ(c − g), set all partial derivatives to zero and solve. The result reproduces the economic rule that marginal benefit per som must be equal across all uses.

lessons.title: Shadow prices and cost minimization
lessons.summary: Interpret the Lagrange multiplier as the value of relaxing a constraint, and minimize the cost of producing a target output.
lessons.body:
The Lagrange multiplier λ has a powerful interpretation: it is the rate at which the optimal value changes when the constraint is relaxed, λ = dV*/dc. In the utility example (maximize x^0.5·y^0.5 with 10x + 5y = 100), λ ≈ 0.0707, so one extra som of income raises maximum utility by about 0.07. This is why λ is called a shadow price: it values a resource that has no market price of its own, such as an hour of machine time or a tonne of emissions allowance.

Cost minimization is the mirror image of output maximization. A firm wants to produce Q = L^0.5·K^0.5 = 100 at minimum cost wL + rK, with wage w = 16 and rental rate r = 4. The first-order conditions give MPL ÷ MPK = w ÷ r, and for this function MPL ÷ MPK = K ÷ L, so K = 4L. Substituting into the target: L^0.5·(4L)^0.5 = 2L = 100, so L = 50 and K = 200. Minimum cost is 16 × 50 + 4 × 200 = 1,600.

Here λ is the marginal cost of output: producing one more unit would raise minimum cost by λ = 2√(w·r) = 16. That gives a direct link between the production technology, input prices and the firm's marginal cost curve.

Key takeaway: the Lagrange multiplier tells you how much the optimum improves per unit of extra resource. In cost minimization it equals marginal cost, and the optimum satisfies MPL/MPK = w/r.

uz.title: Iqtisodiyot uchun matematik tahlil va optimallashtirish
uz.description: Hosila chekli tahlil tili sifatida: xarajat, daromad va naflilik funksiyalarini differensiallang, maksimum va minimumlarni toping hamda Lagranj ko‘paytuvchilari yordamida shartli optimallashtirish masalalarini yeching.

derivatives-marginal.title: Hosilalar va chekli tahlil
derivatives-marginal.summary: Hosila nimani o‘lchaydi, uni qanday hisoblash mumkin va iqtisodchilar hosilalarni chekli miqdorlar sifatida qanday talqin qiladi.

single-variable-optimization.title: Bir o‘zgaruvchili optimallashtirish
single-variable-optimization.summary: Maksimum va minimumlarni toping va tasniflang, so‘ng ularni foyda, xarajat va zaxira bo‘yicha qarorlarga qo‘llang.
